title: Dab
description: Dab on the haters like never before!
body:
Dab on the haters like never before! Use /dab to dab!
![Dab!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5688aeb1874b97fde981cc1c2d9434ac84f99338.gif)

You can even dab in chat using /chatdab!
![Chat dab!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78fe43c3b943b7ca3871a025667d756a3784f4c7.gif)

_Chat dabbing might not be allowed on large servers like Hypixel, however you can still use regular dabbing!_
